chapter_title_en: The Awakening of the Qiongqi Guardians
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 259: Qiongqi Guardians Awaken & Formation Trap Engulfs Ji Ning
chapter_meta_description: Shaoyan Nong’s group flees into a silent Immortal Treasure Hall, only to awaken ancient Qiongqi golems and fall into a deadly sealing formation. Trapped and isolated, can they survive the onslaught?
og_description: Silent for millions of years, the Qiongqi golems stir. Will Ji Ning’s crew survive a sealed hall of death?
twitter_title: Deadly Formation Engulfs the Party in Desolate Era!
twitter_description: The Immortal Mansion fights back. 18 Qiongqi golems activate a trap, cutting off the group from their Fiendgod ally.

lore_anchors.definition: A mythical beast in Chinese folklore, described in the *Classic of Mountains and Seas* as a tiger-headed, ox-bodied creature with wings and spines, known for devouring humans and being a herald of chaos. Here, it is the guardian golem form of the Wu Jiang Immortal Mansion.
A talisman or token that grants its bearer entry into a sealed Immortal’s dwelling, but does not grant full authority over the mansion’s internal defenses or golems.

A superior variant of standard Dao-soldier armor, capable of forming a giant, translucent specter of a hunchbacked giant holding an iron fork; their appearance signals the Wu Jiang clan’s elite military force.

A pivotal fight in Xianxia where a rising cultivator clashes with an established powerhouse to a close result or retreat, functionally announcing their arrival as a major figure regardless of final outcome.
